NEO-ARCHIVE exists at the intersection of brutalist architecture and
contemporary garment design. We reject traditional fashion cycles in favor
of permanent curation. Every piece is an artifact, designed with
uncompromising structural integrity.

itemsSummary.text:
Born from the raw energy of underground streetwear and independent
print media, NEO-ARCHIVE operates on a grid-first philosophy. Every
element is bounded by structural lines, exposing the architecture of the
site as clearly as the garments themselves.

itemsSummary.text:
Our process mirrors the construction of a physical high-end zine. We
employ a rigid border grid, asymmetrical layouts, and zero-pixel gutters.
Depth is achieved through Z-axis hierarchy and deliberate color inversion,
not artificial shadows.
